trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Diagnosis:** The latest release, checkout-api v2.3.1, was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that had been healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rollback:** Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. Verified the service is now healthy with an error rate of 0.2%.
2. **Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0002** documenting the failures, the rollback to v2.3.0, and asking the on-call engineer to verify recovery and investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 failures. The on-call was paged.

Note: the first incident creation request timed out, so I retried with an idempotency key to guarantee the on-call was paged at most once — the retry succeeded.
